eval_script:
# node: node:24-bookworm (from CI)
# install in: ., server (from CI)
# service postgres: docker run -e POSTGRES_USER=bookworm -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=bookworm -e POSTGRES_DB=bookworm_test postgres:16, on the run's own network as host postgres
# DATABASE_URL=postgres://bookworm:bookworm@postgres:5432/bookworm_test
# schema: (
#     cd server
#     pnpm db:push
#   )
set -e
cd /work
git checkout -q -f 4122f9a921e8471c7d4fd06551e1dadf79694787
git clean -fdq
git apply --whitespace=nowarn /patches/test.diff
git apply --whitespace=nowarn /patches/fix.diff
cd /work
if ! { corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; } > /patches/install.log 2>&1; then
  cat /patches/install.log
  echo "[hecate] install failed" >&2
  exit 97
fi
cat /patches/install.log
cd /work/server
if ! { corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; } > /patches/install.log 2>&1; then
  cat /patches/install.log
  echo "[hecate] install failed" >&2
  exit 97
fi
cat /patches/install.log
cd /work
if ! bash -eo pipefail -c '(
  cd server
  pnpm db:push
)' > /patches/schema.log 2>&1; then
  cat /patches/schema.log
  echo "[hecate] schema step failed" >&2
  exit 98
fi
cat /patches/schema.log
mkdir -p /patches/reports
export REPORT_DIR=/patches/reports
cd /work/server
REPORT=$REPORT_DIR/node-0.json node --test --test-reporter=/patches/reporter.mjs "backend_tests/*.test.ts" || true
